meta.title: Tzevet Hatzolah
meta.description: Tzevet Hatzolah — volunteer emergency rescue organization active 24/7 across Israel.

hero.badge: Volunteer Emergency Organization · Always on call
hero.title_line2: That's all the time we have.
hero.subtitle: In the critical seconds between the call and the ambulance — hundreds of volunteers save lives.

mission.title: Who We Are
mission.text: For decades, Tzevet Hatzolah has worked to save lives and provide first-response medical assistance in real time, with dedication and professionalism while respecting the volunteers' way of life.

donate_block.title: Donate Now — Save Lives
donate_block.subtitle: Every donation — monthly or one-time — directly equips another volunteer in the field. Choose the equipment you'd like to help fund, or give any amount.

ticker.item2: Over 500 active volunteers across the country
ticker.item4: Join us — Donate now and save lives
